name: Harshith Vankela
tagline: Building at the intersection of AI, quantum systems, and entrepreneurship.
shortBio: Student, researcher, and builder. I study how computation and physics converge — and how ideas become ventures.
fullBio: I'm driven by a simple premise: the most interesting problems live between disciplines. My work spans artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and the psychology of human decision-making — not because these fields are trendy, but because their intersections reveal how reality actually works.

I build things to understand them. Whether it's a quantum circuit simulator, an ML system, or a startup prototype, each project is a lens into a different layer of complexity. I write to think clearly, and I share because ideas compound when they're in the open.

Outside of research, I train calisthenics — the discipline of mastering your own body mirrors the discipline of mastering complex systems. I believe in compounding curiosity, long-term thinking, and the quiet work that precedes any visible result.
philosophy: The most meaningful insights emerge at the intersections of disciplines. Physics informs computation, psychology informs design, and entrepreneurship turns ideas into impact. I'm not interested in credentials — I'm interested in understanding.
